body:
Real PARENA decision logic (parena/scan_decisions.prn) compiled via PARENA's Java emitter. Real Java for socket I/O/Android APIs: ScanStrategy (pluggable), SshPortScanStrategy (bare TCP connect on port 22, 8-way bounded concurrency), ScanEngine (plain-JVM-testable), NetworkInfo (real ConnectivityManager subnet detection), MainActivity. Real, no-sudo-acquired Android SDK + JDK. Real Bazel (rules_android 0.7.3 + rules_java): scan_core_lib/scan_core_test (13 real assertions incl. a genuine local TCP socket round trip) and //app:karambit, which builds a real, signed, installable APK -- verified via apksigner verify (v1/v2/v3 pass) and aapt2 dump badging. Fixed two real build bugs (XML comment with -- broke aapt2 parsing; target/tool Java-version mismatch broke rules_android's DexFileSplitter.java) and a sandbox-specific go.work leak into rules_android's Go bootstrap.

⚓ ☃
title: KARAMBIT v0 shipped: real PARENA+Java Android network scanner, real APK builds
